item.skycraft.lockpick.desc: Used to pick locked chests. Fragile.
crime.skycraft.confiscated: Your stolen items have been confiscated (%s)
crime.skycraft.guard.cant_afford: You don't have enough gold. Then you'll serve your time.
crime.skycraft.guard.bribed_line: %s: I didn't see anything. Get lost.
crime.skycraft.guard.intimidated_line: %s: All right, all right. Just move along.
crime.skycraft.guard.persuade_failed: I can't let you off. Pay the fine or come with me.
crime.skycraft.guard.intimidate_failed: You won't intimidate me. You're under arrest.
dialogue.skycraft.crime.jail: I submit. Take me to jail.
dialogue.skycraft.crime.resist: I'd rather die than go to prison! (Resist)
crime.skycraft.rumor.0: Took a frostbite spider's bite on patrol last winter. Leg's never been the same.
crime.skycraft.rumor.1: If you've been robbed, report it to the steward. If you're the robber, I'd keep walking.
crime.skycraft.rumor.3: Move along. The Jarl doesn't pay me to chat.
crime.skycraft.rumor.4: Keep your nose clean, and you won't have any trouble with me.
crime.skycraft.rumor.5: Plenty of folk lost their purses on the market square last week. Keep a hand on yours.
crime.skycraft.rumor.6: Heard tell of bandits camped in the hills. Wouldn't wander there alone.
crime.skycraft.rumor.7: The law's the only thing between this hold and the wolves. Mind it.
crime.skycraft.lock.need_pick: This %s is locked (%s). You need a lockpick.
crime.skycraft.lock.cant_break: It's locked (%s). Pick the lock instead.
crime.skycraft.pickpocket.caught_line: %s: Hey! Get your hands off me!
crime.skycraft.jail.title: Jail
crime.skycraft.jail.deteriorate: Your time in jail has caused your skills to deteriorate.
crime.skycraft.jail.served_sleep: Sleep in your cell bed to be released, or break out.
crime.skycraft.jail.out_of_cell: %s: You, out of your cell? Stop right there!
crime.skycraft.jail.dragged_back: %s drags you back to your cell. %s seconds are added to your sentence.
item.skycraft.jail_key.desc: Property of the jail. It opens the jail's doors and goods, and nothing outside; the guards take it back when you leave.
crime.skycraft.jail.evidence_returned: The jail gives back what it took from you (%s items).
crime.skycraft.jail.evidence_empty: The jail holds nothing of yours.
crime.skycraft.jail.loading_tip: The guards walk you to your cell.
crime.skycraft.jail.visitor_warn: %s: This is for the guard. Out, now.
crime.skycraft.jail.visitor_trespass: You were told to leave. Trespassing.
crime.skycraft.jail.freed_player: You free %s. Get out before the guards see.
crime.skycraft.jail.freed_npc: %s slips out of the cell and away.
crime.skycraft.jail.aiding_seen: A guard saw you aid an escape.
crime.skycraft.jail.alarm: %s raises the alarm! The jail is locked down.
dialogue.skycraft.crime.prisoner_rumor: What have you heard in here?
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.0: The guards change at the gate when the bell goes. There is a quiet while they do.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.1: Somebody found a way out through the drain, once. Never saw him again, mind.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.2: The keeper's key hangs on the guard by the window. Light fingers, steady hands.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.3: They say the jarl's steward sells pardons. Cheaper than the lawyers, dearer than the truth.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.4: Don't run in the corridor. Sound carries on stone.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.rumor.5: A cut purse, a bit of poaching, a name said wrong at the wrong table. Half of us are in for less than that.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.why.0: Caught with a stolen ring. I swear I only held it for a friend.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.why.1: Poaching the jarl's deer. One deer. Look at me, I could not feed a cat.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.why.2: A fight over a card game. He cheated; I was the one who bled the carpet.
crime.skycraft.prisoner.why.3: They say I am a smuggler. They say a lot of things.
hud.skycraft.crime.served: Sentence served - sleep in your bed to be released
screen.skycraft.pickpocket.title: Pickpocket: %s
screen.skycraft.pickpocket.hint: Click an item to steal it. Esc to stop.
screen.skycraft.lockpick.title: Lockpicking
screen.skycraft.lockpick.hint: Mouse: move the pick   Hold A / D: turn the lock   Esc: stop
